# Visuals code
sharpInteractiveVisuals.min.js creates a <canvas> element. Current CSS for that was simply:

canvas {
  display: block;
}

# p5.js library

p5.js is required. I've added the library to the folder but you can also call it via cdn:

<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/p5.js/1.11.1/p5.js"></script>


# Optimization

Code is not optmized, but should work on most desktop envrionments.
Not tested for mobile.
